mission: Enter the thin-place valley and experience localized de-structuring firsthand to understand what the group will face at Veranthos.
why_now: The thin-place valley is on their route and represents the first opportunity to directly experience localized de-structuring before reaching the primary wound. Preparation requires understanding.
conflict: Ben vs. disorientation of localized Force anomaly
turning_point: Divergent reactions to the thin place fracture the group along philosophical lines: Torin found it peaceful, Kael found it honest, Sera refused to enter.
setting: Former New Sith Wars battlefield world; thin-place valley
emotional_trajectory: Same phenomenon means different things depending on training and history
notes: Group exits shaken and more divided. Torin found it peaceful (wrong reaction). Kael found it honest (unsettling implication). Sera refused to enter.
